arguments.why: We spoke to Freya on 11 Dec about completion and invoicing but have no written confirmation; we need this before closing the job.

arguments.body:
Hello Henry,

A quick update on the communal garden and hedge work. The landlord's contractor, Riverside Services, has been working on it and we are now asking them for written confirmation that it is finished. Once we have it, we will let you know. We will update you again by 16 December at the latest. If anything still looks untidy after the work, please tell us.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email requests to Freya (contractor) and to the landlord for completion and payment confirmation, plus a tenant update email. Follow-up is set for 15 Dec.

answers.answer: No. This is routine chasing and nothing is above authority. If no replies come by the 15 Dec review, chase again on another channel.
